decisions.approved_statement: Roots Access is required to enter Roots; individual Level Access items are superseded.
prohibited_interpretations: Roots content requires no Area Access item.

decisions.approved_statement: An AP location check sends the randomized item placed there and does not guarantee its thematically associated item.
prohibited_interpretations: Collecting an AP location always grants its thematically associated item.
An AP location and its randomized item are the same concept.

decisions.approved_statement: Level 4's pickup is a Hip Glasses source location; Hip Glasses is separately a randomized item; the normal Bucket Minion trade is the Chicken Bucket source location; Chicken Bucket is separately a randomized item; Combo Bucket remains a vanilla consequence.
prohibited_interpretations: Hip Glasses and Chicken Bucket source locations guarantee those items.
Combo Bucket is a randomized AP item.

decisions.approved_statement: Gameplay observations remain evidence, while pre-pivot per-level design conclusions are not current requirements.
prohibited_interpretations: Historical per-level access design remains a current requirement.
Historical gameplay observations should be discarded.

decisions.approved_statement: Unknown native identifiers must remain unknown and must never be invented.
prohibited_interpretations: A plausible native identifier may be inferred without evidence.
Missing native mappings may be presented as confirmed.
